simple.meaning: תָּאַב (tâʼab) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to loathe (morally).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Amos, beginning at Amos 6:8. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תָּאַב (H8374) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: תָּאַב (tâʼab) / H8374 is traced through Amos 6:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H8374. taab II. [ תָּאַב ] verb Pi`el loathe, abhor , see תעב .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root (probably identical with 8373 through the idea of puffing disdainfully at; compare 340 );
